name: Warrior Priest
description: With fire burning in their eyes, the Warrior-Priests stride into battle, chanting aloud the Deus Sigmar, the praise of the patron god of the Empire.

abilities.name: Voice of Sigmar
abilities.text: Increase the Bravery characteristic of all visible friendly fighters within 3" of this fighter by 1. In addition, if this fighter is recruited by a `WITCH HUNTER` warband, you may increase the warband's Zeal by 1 whenever this fighter uses an ability.

abilities.name: Denounce
abilities.text: A fighter may use this reaction when a visible fighter within 6" is the target of a magical ability. Roll a d6: if the result is higher than this fighter’s Bravery characteristic, the ability is cancelled and the ability dice discarded.

abilities.name: Hammer of Sigmar
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if equipped with a Warhammer or Sigmarite Hammer. Add (X/2) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from the next melee attack action made by this fighter in this activation.
